Hi Sam — thanks for the note and the context, happy to help. Below are our standard hosted list rates per 1M tokens (input/output split shown separately). I'm attaching the Q1 ratecard PDF with model names and short descriptions for reference.

List rates (per 1M tokens, USD):
- Redwood-4 (high-capacity generation/chat) — $120 per 1M input tokens / $140 per 1M output tokens
- Redwood-3.5 (cost-optimized generation) — $18 per 1M input tokens / $22 per 1M output tokens
- text-embedding-3 (embeddings) — $6 per 1M tokens

Notes:
- We report input and output tokens separately (requests vs. responses). Billing rounds to the nearest 1,000 tokens.
- Volume tiers (example list discounts off list): >50M tokens: 10% off; >200M: 18% off; >1B: contact for bespoke pricing and capacity planning.
- Standard new-customer minimums for a Sales-assisted contract: $25k monthly commit (negotiable for trials).

Attached: redwood-hosted-ratecard-q1-2026.pdf (model names + recommended variants)

If you can share a ballpark of expected monthly token consumption and any SLO/latency needs, I can propose a pricing/commit path and check whether we have any available promotional credits.

Cheers,

Sam — thanks for the quick follow-ups. Short answers and next steps: 

1) SKU names: redwood-4-base, redwood-4-v2-small, redwood-3.5-base, redwood-3.5-cost, text-embedding-3. The attached ratecard PDF lists recommended variants for chat vs. instruction workloads.
2) Token counting: we count tokens from the request body/prompt and the generated response. Small routing metadata in headers is not counted unless it is included in the prompt payload.
3) Burst: we can support short bursts for hosted customers within reasonable limits; sustained burst beyond committed throughput should be covered via a short-term capacity reservation or moving to Dedicated. Marcus will confirm technical constraints.
4) Commit/tiers: Laura approved a promotional path — we can offer 15% off list for the first 6 months with a $50k total commit. That is a promotional addendum applicable to hosted API only. After the promo, billing reverts to list with applicable volume tiers.

If that works, I'll send a one-page commercial addendum and a DocuSign link to sign (and an NDA if you'd like). Please confirm whether you want the $50k total commit or prefer a month-to-month trial first.

Next steps:
- Confirm preference (commit vs. month-to-month trial)
- I'll push addendum + DocuSign and set up a tech sync with Marcus for capacity and latency SLOs
